browserTests.note: This is an aggregate of 22 unique passing scenarios across six counted runs. The initial run passed all 13 leg and manikin scenarios; its six failures remain recorded. Four hand scenarios passed through a temporary diagnostic clone whose harness, probe, helpers and test bodies match the saved hand fixture byte-for-byte. Its default report destination and failure capture hook differ. The recovery diagnostic run passed the recovery case and failed its phone case; the phone case passed in a fresh phone-only run. The first five-case detail run recorded four passes and one absent-target serialization failure. The final browser process passed all five detail cases after the probe serialized an absent target as null. Its wrapper exited 1 when the shared module raw hash changed; the actual guard result is preserved and accepted under the scoped current-versus-parent audit exception. The other 25 final-run inputs stayed unchanged.

refinements: Palm-facing detail camera follows the actual near hand with a slight outward angle
Actual palm and enabled arrow vertices fit without changing model scale or shared renderer
Detail refits after pose, arm-guide, age or viewer-size changes
Completed before-turn and after-turn shortcuts preserve progress and recorded inquiry
Phone keyboard, spacing, forced-color and app-contrast controls
coverage: 42 age/pose/guide geometry combinations on desktop and phone in unit tests
Native 1280px to 320px to 1280px refitting with the same canvas
Missing-target reset, manual orbit preservation, rebuild and detach cleanup
Existing contact, arm, leg, recovery and facial inspections
One app-created drawn WebGL context, context restoration and unmount cleanup
